Encapsulation, Abstraction & Access Modifiers

Why good classes hide their data behind behaviour, how that protects the rules (invariants) an object promises, what private, protected, package-private and public really mean in Java and C++, and why "tell, don't ask" beats a wall of getters and setters. You already do this in C with opaque handles; here you will see the same idea with compiler help.
